Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority,

education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the

IS : 10883- 1984 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SINGLE WHEEL TYPE PIPE CUTTERS 



( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 



CO 



1- Scope — Covers the dimensional and other requirements of single-wheel type pipe cutters used 
for cutting steel and wrought iron pipes in the range of 6 to 150 mm external diameter. 

2. Shape, Capacities and Dimensions

2.3 Dimensions — The dimensions of component parts of pipe cutters shall be as given in Table 2 
and Table 3. 

2.3.1 Tolerances — Tolerances on the untoleranced dimensions shall be in accordance with 
IS : 2102 ( Part 1 )-1980 * General tolerances for linear and angular dimensions ( second revision )'. 

2.3.2 The illustrations are diagrammatic only and are not intended to give details of design.

IS: 10883 -«&r 

3. Designation — Single-wheel type pipe cutter shall be designated by the nominal sizerantfihe* 
number of this standard. 

Example : 

A pipe cutter of nominal size 5 (suitable for pipe diameters between 80 to 15frrrrm > 
shall be designated as: 

Single-Wheel Pipe Cutter 5 IS : f0883 

4- General Requirements — Requirements regarding material, hardness, workmanship and ftrtish, 
tests, packing and sampling shall conform to IS : 6843-1984 * Technical supply conditions for pipe 
cutters {first revision )\ 

5. Marking — Single wheel type pipe cutter shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initial 
and/or recognized trade-mark, nominal size and the range of capacity. 

5-1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

While preparing this specification considerable assistance has been derived from the data 
supplied by the leading manufacturers of this product.
